lines.en: Hello. One coffee and one juice, please.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 커피 하나와 주스 하나 주세요.

lines.en: Sure. Do you want milk in your coffee?
Yes, a little milk. No sugar, please.
lines.ko: 네, 우유 조금요. 설탕은 넣지 마세요.

lines.en: What juice do you want, apple or orange?
lines.ko: 주스는 사과랑 오렌지 중에 뭘로 드릴까요?

lines.en: Orange juice for my grandson. He loves it.
lines.ko: 손자 줄 오렌지 주스요. 아주 좋아해요.

lines.en: Last time you drank tea here.
Yes, but today I want to taste your coffee.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 오늘은 이 집 커피를 맛보고 싶어요.

lines.en: Great. Here is your cup. Be careful, it's hot.
Thank you. How much is it?
Two thousand. I will bring the juice soon.
Come in. Would you like a cup of tea?
Yes, thank you. What tea is this?
It's green tea. Taste it.
Wow, it tastes good. Do you put sugar in?
No sugar, no milk. Just tea and water.
lines.ko: 설탕도 우유도 안 넣어요. 그냥 차와 물이에요.

lines.en: When I was young, I drank coffee every day.
Coffee is nice, but tea is better for sleep.
lines.ko: 커피도 좋지만 차가 잠에는 더 좋아요.

lines.en: Then I will drink tea from now on.
Good. Next time I will make some juice too.
Thank you. Your tea is the best drink.
